Pooled boundary view

Relabelled 2026-10-19 (RC19B erratum F; numbers unchanged). One pool of 541 SPH simulations, learned from scratch (final repeat 3). Each dot is a run at its recorded held-out prediction after b paid simulations. These colours come from five different learners: every run is coloured by the learner of the fold in which it was held out. The diamonds are the paid runs of one of those five learners only, so they are not the training data of most dots. For a single learner with its own grid predictions, use the single-learner view. The fourth input ST is filtered explicitly.

inside, predicted inside
outside, predicted outside
outside, predicted inside (false alarm)
inside, predicted outside (miss)
paid by the chosen fold's learner (training runs of that one learner only)

"Inside" = spike log-ratio ≥ log 2 (region) or Keyhole (label). Numbers on this page are computed from the recorded predictions; they equal the evaluator's (checked when the page was built). Evidence label: DEV — all simulations were inspected before; a new split is not new physical data.
